name: fig_portfolio
caption: Protocol-defined capability coverage of eleven Full Study cases; filled cells identify task requirements rather than independent performance scores.

name: fig_research_decisions
caption: Selected PHS-2D decisions link local diagnostics, failed finite-load tests and geometry checks to the frozen design. Local and finite-load quantities have different scopes and do not form a convergence curve.

name: fig_tracking_path
caption: World y–z projection of the complete 22 s archived trajectory and 89 stored target nodes. Full 3D evaluator RMSE is 0.68785 mm and maximum error is 1.02066 mm; no interpolated target/error curve is introduced.

name: fig_impact_position
caption: Archived 10 ms sampled position signals under one common feedback recipe. Pulse: 0.50–0.55 s; final hold: 0.90–1.00 s. Dotted line denotes the hold bound, applicable to required hold windows. Three required cases pass; both frozen controls fail the complete evaluator. Sampled curves do not replace full-step acceptance.

name: fig_phs_point_x_abs_m
caption: Frozen F8 in ten formal conditions. Force-point displacement (mm) is evaluated per condition; dashed line is the original lower bound. No search-stage values are connected to formal acceptance.

name: fig_phs_tip_projected_m
caption: Frozen F8 in ten formal conditions. Projected Tip displacement (mm) is evaluated per condition; dashed line is the original upper bound. No search-stage values are connected to formal acceptance.

name: fig_phs_ratio
caption: Frozen F8 in ten formal conditions. Tip / force-point ratio is evaluated per condition; dashed line is the original upper bound. No search-stage values are connected to formal acceptance.

name: fig_position_axis_constraints
caption: Position and directed-axis errors divided by their respective original upper bounds. Quantities retain their units and thresholds in the CSV; normalized bars are not a common task score.

name: fig_resource_math_evaluations
caption: Resource use of the selected Full task series, including its failed/preparatory studies. Only disjoint run IDs within a series are summed; superseded batch duplicates and PHS half-step verification are excluded. Math charges, physical episode launches and nested integration steps use different definitions and are shown separately. Incomplete step totals are explicitly lower bounds.
